rulings.restated: Input — The amount of this property's cost you elect to expense under section 179 (zero if none; not more than its business cost). Only section 179 property qualifies: property you acquired by purchase for use in the active conduct of your business that is tangible personal property or off-the-shelf computer software, or other tangible property (not a building or its structural components) used as an integral part of manufacturing, production or extraction or of furnishing transportation, communications, electricity, gas, water or sewage disposal services (or as a research or bulk storage facility used with those activities), or qualified improvement property you elect to treat as section 179 property. Enter zero for land and land improvements (such as swimming pools, paved parking areas, wharves, docks, bridges and fences), property held for investment, and property you purchased and lease to others, unless you manufactured or produced it, or the lease term is less than 50% of its class life and for the first 12 months after the transfer to the lessee your deductions for it as trade or business expenses (other than rents and reimbursed amounts) are more than 15% of its rental income. Also enter zero for property used by a tax-exempt organization (unless used in connection with the production of income subject to the tax on unrelated trade or business income) and property used by a governmental unit or a foreign person or entity (unless used under a lease with a term of less than 6 months). If you paid for it with cash and a trade-in, the elected cost cannot be more than the cash you paid.
rulings.model: The restatement says 'Only section 179 property qualifies' and gives a list that leaves out IRS-qualifying property that is not screened out. The IRS list includes 'Single purpose agricultural (livestock) or horticultural structures' and 'Storage facilities (except buildings and their structural components) used in connection with distributing petroleum or any primary product of petroleum.' A filer with such property would be told to enter zero.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding (low; pre-existing, not introduced by the package); i4562 p. 2 lists as section 179 property "Storage facilities (except buildings and their structural components) used in connection with distributing petroleum or any primary product of petroleum" and "Single purpose agricultural (livestock) or horticultural structures". The question's list omits both. Single purpose structures are class 01.4, which class_lives maps to outside (refused at asset.outside), so only the petroleum storage facilities are reachable: such a filer is told only listed property qualifies and may enter zero. The earlier ruling recorded this under BUG-0326/T-183, which BUG-0373 now closes without this item; see bklg/asset.findings.md. The wording the package added (tax-exempt, governmental and foreign users) matches p946 p. 17.

A filer with such property may not elect; it changes no amount the tool computes for property it does list.
